title: Transplant status and rejection
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's transplant status or transplant complication only.
note:
Chief Complaint: Follow-up for remission status.

HPI: (Copied Forward) Patient is a 57-year-old female who underwent an allogeneic stem cell transplant two years ago. She is currently in remission. She reports feeling well with no new symptoms since the last visit.

Update: The patient reports continued stability and denies any new concerns. She maintains a regular exercise routine and feels her energy levels are consistent.

Medication List:
- Multivitamin daily
- Vitamin D3 2000 IU daily

Vitals: BP 128/82, HR 74, SpO2 98% on room air, Temp 98.6 F, BMI 26.4

Review of Systems:
Constitutional: Negative
Respiratory: Negative
Cardiovascular: Negative
Gastrointestinal: Negative
Genitourinary: Negative
Musculoskeletal: Negative
Neurological: Negative
Skin: Negative

Exam:
General: Well-appearing, alert, and oriented x3.
Skin: No new lesions noted.
Lymphatic: No lymphadenopathy.
Respiratory: Clear to auscultation bilaterally.
Cardiovascular: Regular rate and rhythm, no murmurs.

Assessment:
1. Status post allogeneic stem cell transplant, currently in remission.

Plan:
1. Continue current surveillance and routine follow-up.
2. Return to clinic in 6 months for scheduled monitoring.

Electronically signed, S. Patel, NP, 05/14/2026

distractors.why: A stem cell transplant is documented, not bone marrow.
